title: Official blog reviewed authoring stage 15
summary: This iteration adds an internal reviewed-authoring validation step for OpenAI and Anthropic official-blog templates. It consumes completed Stage 14 human templates, validates them with the same constraints used by the final author-record step, keeps manual-review items separate, reports incomplete templates as invalid entries, and emits a sanitized internal handoff without writing curated records or public artifacts.

lessons.lesson: Completed authoring templates need an internal validation gate before curated records are written.
lessons.evidence: Stage 15 produces `official_blog_reviewed_authoring` and reuses final draft-entry validation before emitting `reviewed_entries`.
lessons.recommended_action: Run `official-blog:reviewed-authoring` on completed authoring briefs before `official-blog:author-records`.

lessons.lesson: Manual-review items must remain blocked even when they contain completed-looking fields.
lessons.evidence: Stage 15 reads only `authoring_items[].reviewed_entry_template`; `manual_review_required` items are summarized separately and never promoted.
lessons.recommended_action: Promote customer or partnership stories only after a separate explicit review turns them into accepted authoring items.

lessons.lesson: Authoring validation should produce a clean internal artifact rather than partial public data.
lessons.evidence: The Stage 15 CLI refuses public output paths and strips opening previews, bodies, transcripts, source audit, and candidate pools from reviewed-authoring output.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep reviewed-authoring artifacts under internal working paths until curated records are explicitly written.

suggestions.issue: Completed Stage 14 templates had no deterministic validation checkpoint before the final author-record write command.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 15 adds `createOfficialBlogReviewedAuthoring` and `official-blog:reviewed-authoring`, plus tests for completed-template validation, manual-review isolation, clean JSON output, invalid incomplete templates, and public output guards.
suggestions.suggestion: Validate completed official-blog authoring briefs into an internal reviewed-authoring artifact before writing curated knowledge records.
suggestions.expected_benefit: The official-blog workflow gains a deterministic quality gate between human translation/synthesis and persistent knowledge graph updates.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through pure function and CLI coverage, with public output guards and internal payload sanitization.
validation_evidence: official blog reviewed authoring validates completed templates and keeps manual items separate
official-blog:reviewed-authoring CLI writes clean internal reviewed authoring
official-blog:reviewed-authoring CLI refuses public output paths

followups.action: Add a wrapper runbook command that executes preview feed, intake, review packet, review decisions, authoring brief, reviewed authoring, relation suggestions, and author-record writes as explicit auditable steps.
Add public official-blog index integration only after internal reviewed-authoring and author-record artifacts have stable examples.
